name: Mārketinga Skola
tagline: Digitālā Mārketinga Aģentūra, kas Palīdz Tavam Biznesam Augt!

analytics._comment: ga4Id (G-XXXXXXXXXX) loads gtag.js, metaPixelId loads the Meta pixel, gtmId (GTM-XXXXXXX) loads a container. All empty = no analytics and no cookie banner. src/js/consent.js shows the banner and loads nothing until 'Piekrītu'; preview builds (PREVIEW=1) never load either.
analytics._ga4Note: Direct GA4 was chosen over GTM on 6 Sep 2026: the GTM-MVJJGQ4 container still holds a dead Universal Analytics tag and a Facebook Pixel from 2020 that would fire on All Pages the moment the container was published.
analytics._capiNote: n8n relay that forwards the same events to the Meta Conversions API. LIVE since 7 Sep 2026 (workflow KiiDciCuUsCc3ezc, verified events_received:1). Empty = browser pixel only. The site hashes email/phone before sending, so n8n never sees raw personal data. The secret is visible in client JS by design: it stops drive-by noise, it is not authentication.
analytics._auditNote: Lead magnet: the popup posts a URL here and renders the returned checks inline. n8n workflow PxXdIWi34gIyEfMz. Empty = the popup never renders.
analytics._adsNote: Google Ads tag (12 Nov 2026), loaded by consent.js only after 'Piekrītu', like GA4. googleAdsLabels maps a GA4 event name to a conversion label in that account; an event without a label sends no Google Ads conversion. Account 629-727-4403 (billing SIA Stonks); until Mārketinga Skola has its own conversion actions there, these are the account's existing Lead and Contact actions, which Impromotion uses too. Conversions are credited to the clicked ad, so the two sites cannot mix inside a campaign.
